title: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
before: Multimodality was added to text models afterwards, by bolting on an encoder.
problem: A bolted-on encoder limits how deeply modalities can interact.
breakthrough: A model family trained on text, images, audio and video from the start, across three sizes.
why: It established native multimodality as the frontier design and put Google back in direct competition.
next: Gemini 1.5's million-token context, then the 2.5 and 3 generations.
inherits: Natively multimodal training rather than adapter bridges.
